verdict.rationale: Stripe's Identity docs include copy-pasteable curl examples against the live verification_sessions endpoint. A published OpenAPI spec and a test-mode sandbox let those examples be run safely, but nothing shows an interactive reference where calls execute in the browser. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API reference explorer, in-page runnable or try-it examples, auto-filled test keys, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: This API tracks a verification, from initial creation through the entire verification process, and shows verification results upon completion.
